# yubico — Yubico OTP

[All groups](README.md)

## yubico otp

Decode a Yubico OTP: modhex public ID (and serial when it encodes one) and token; with the AES key, decrypt the token, check its CRC, private ID and counters (replay detection).

MCP tool: `yubico_otp`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--otp` | string | The OTP as typed by the YubiKey. **Required.** |
| `--aes-key` | string | The slot's AES-128 key, hex. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_AES_KEY`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--private-id` | string | Expected private ID, hex. |
| `--last-usage-counter` | int | Last usage counter seen for this key. |
| `--last-session-counter` | int | Last session counter seen. Default `0`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
